text_en: China's Ministry of Commerce spokesperson answers reporters' questions on adjustments to the export control list measures. According to The Paper, China has not yet approved the import of about 600,000 advanced Nvidia chips; the Foreign Ministry: suggest asking the competent authorities. According to The Paper, a US official said a woman involved in an extramarital affair with Jensen Huang works for a Chinese intelligence agency; the Foreign Ministry: purely baseless. Trump is set to meet a key mediator and says he has no intention of escalating the Iran conflict; Rubio pours cold water: talks are far from a breakthrough. Brent crude falls over 3%! Iran is reported to have softened its stance on the Hormuz issue, and the president says he is willing to break the "neither war nor peace" deadlock through negotiations. Musk's Terafab target revealed: aiming for monthly production of 700,000 memory chip wafers, close to Samsung's total DRAM capacity. Google launches two new TPUs to challenge Nvidia's dominance!
